displayName: 乌尔奇奥拉·西法 Ulquiorra Cifer
description: Unofficial Ulquiorra Cifer fan-art companion inspired by Bleach, with original leaf handling, collar-tidying, book care and running animations. The ordinary Arrancar appearance retains the physical left head fragment and teal tear marks. The opaque closed white coat, full trousers and covered shoes simplify the costume, and the torso cavity is omitted as a conservative desktop adaptation. No wings, transformation or weapon. This independent companion is not official or endorsed.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
